sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 – alternatives for stable continued supply
move.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

We value our twelve-year cooperation and want a package that supports dependable production and a healthy foundry. The wage movement and cost share you describe do not explain the whole proposed increase; please provide your current full cost per housing, the energy and wage components, and your financing cost so we can understand the remaining drivers.

Please reconcile the proposed start date with the notice provisions in doc:D01-LETTER and ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK.
Our PH-100 should-cost record cost:part:PH-100 is the basis for requesting a closer review of the increase.
The historical PH-100 orders po:4500001201, po:4500001288 and po:4500001342 provide the price baseline for that review.

We propose three alternatives, all with FCA and 35-day lead time unchanged:
A: EUR 47.00 per unit, 30 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01.
B: EUR 46.50 per unit, 60 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-01-01.
C: EUR 47.00 per unit, 30 days net, 12 months, effective 2027-04-01.

For A we retain your prompt payment terms and offer a longer commitment against price restraint. Which structure best fits your production and cash requirements?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As a proud family-run foundry, we treat our internal cost structures as confidential, but we are pleased to support your need for dependable production by accepting a 24-month contract. 

Trading this extended 24-month commitment against your prompt 30-day payment terms, we propose a revised price of €50.10 per unit starting in February. Our current offer is a price of €50.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. 

Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: a price of €50.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 – revised 24-month proposal
move.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for recognising the supporting records and the value of a longer commitment. We respect the confidentiality of your cost structure; an aggregate cost movement or confirmation of the margin needed for dependable supply would suffice, without disclosing individual accounts.

The delivery record in sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2 and sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3 should also inform the balance between the requested increase and dependable supply.

We withdraw the 60-day payment alternative and retain your 30-day cash cycle. For the April structure, we increase our proposal to EUR 47.30 per unit, 30 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01; FCA and the 35-day lead time remain unchanged. Please review the price against this firm longer-term commitment and prompt payment.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We value our long-standing relationship and have reviewed the delivery records you cited; they hold, but do not alter our pricing structure. Please understand that as a family-run foundry, we keep our margins and aggregate cost movements strictly confidential. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

In response to your improved offer, we are pleased to reduce our price to €49.80 for the 24-month commitment starting in April. Specifically, we present a price of €49.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 – further price movement and payment alternatives
move.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for your price movement. We respect your decision to keep margins internal and will not pursue that disclosure further.

We increase the 30-day proposal from EUR 47.30 to EUR 47.75 per unit, retaining 24 months and an effective date of 2027-04-01. We also offer higher prices for longer payment terms so you can assess the financing trade:
A: EUR 47.75 per unit, 30 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01.
B: EUR 47.90 per unit, 45 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01.
C: EUR 48.05 per unit, 60 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01.
FCA and the 35-day lead time remain unchanged for all three.

Please review the additional price movement against your April offer and indicate which payment structure you can support, including the corresponding price for any alternative.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In response to your movement, we are pleased to reduce our price to €49.50 for the 24-month commitment with 30 days net. Our complete proposal stands at a price of €49.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.

To answer your question, we prefer to maintain the 30-day payment terms, as prompt payment best supports our operations. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. It has always been a point of pride for our family-run foundry to work closely alongside long-standing partners like Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we deeply value the trust built between our companies over many years in our region. 

Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for clarifying your payment preference. We retain 30 days net and withdraw the longer-payment alternatives.

In response to your reduction, we increase our 30-day proposal by EUR 0.30 to EUR 48.05 per unit, with a 24-month contract effective 2027-04-01, FCA and a 35-day lead time unchanged. This combines further price movement from us with the prompt payment and longer commitment that support your operations. Please review your April price on that basis.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
